content:
Today's special edition of 9to5Toys Lunch Break brings you an update—AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 are down $120, marking one of the lowest prices ever, and Best Buy is celebrating its 60th anniversary with a one-day-only Apple discount event.

Along with AirTag 2 dropping back to its historical low, today you can also find the all-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $400 off, the iPhone Air at $170 off (open-box units can save you up to $406), and deals on a range of official Apple accessories.
